title: Journey Home:
title_short: Day 1 PM · What Journey Home needs
headline: Three ways to help, shown on one desk: a cheque for giving, a watch for time, and your voice.
story: People keep asking Dwayne what Journey Home needs. He answers with objects on his desk: a cheque for giving, a watch for time, and your voice to speak up for better care.
The best line is the last one: care that gives people “a hand up and not just another hand out.” Simple, warm, practical. End on the ask.
do: Open on frame 1 with his question and the hook text.
Push in to the cheque on “check” and to the watch on “watch”.
Blur the cheque's number line, number and name in every frame.
Give “a hand up” half a second of air.
Show the ask as text: Comment “I'm in”.
dont: No logo, title card or fade at 0:00. The logo is only on the end card.
Do not slow his voice to reach 35 s.
